name: Configure Domain Resource Limits and Quotas
description:
The greenvalley.test virtual server is currently running with unlimited resource allocation, which is a hosting risk. Configure the following resource limits for this domain through Virtualmin:

1. Set the disk quota to 500 MB (both server and user quotas).
2. Set the bandwidth limit to 5 GB per month.
3. Set the maximum number of mailboxes allowed to 10.
4. Set the maximum number of aliases allowed to 20.
5. Set the maximum number of databases allowed to 3.

Virtualmin is accessible at https://localhost:10000/. Login credentials: root / GymAnything123!
